Repair the interrupted hair with continuous, naturally flowing long tapered blue locks matching the adjacent painting, fine hair-strand texture and navy-to-cyan gradient. Do not center, rotate, enlarge, mirror, add margins, or redesign. Keep the upper attachment edge and root at the same pixels. Output one clean isolated hair-only layer matching the reference's entire 620 by 1024 frame, as close as possible to identical registration, suitable for restoring the original rig. Keep the fine anime illustration finish, not blurred or simplified.
